discussion on 42 year old male with fever "},"content":{"type":"html","$t":"\u003Cp\u003E\u0026nbsp;This is an online E logbook to discuss our patients' de-identified health data shared after taking his\/her\/guardian's signed informed consent. Here we discuss our individual patient's problems through series of inputs from the available global online community of experts intending to solve those patients' clinical problems with the collective current best evidence-based inputs. This e-log book also reflects my patient-centered online learning portfolio and your valuable inputs on the comment box are welcome.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EI have been given this case to solve in an attempt to understand the topic of \" Patient clinical data analysis\" to develop my competency in reading and comprehending clinical data including history, clinical findings, and investigations, and come up with a diagnosis and treatment plan.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ECASE DISCUSSION\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E42 year old male was brought with complaints of fever since 1 day with 1 episode of vomiting 1 day back.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EHistory of presenting illness: The patient was apparently asymptomatic 1 day back when he developed fever which was incidious in onset, gradually progressive, high grade and relived on medication.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EIt was associated with chills and rigours and also burning micturition since 1 day.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EHowever, he does not give history of any urgency or hesitancy in urinating.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EHe claims to have a decreased urine output since 4 days.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThe 1 episode of vomiting, was around 1 pm the previous day. It was non bilious, non projectile, non blood stained with food as content.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ENo other complaints of any headache, neck stiffness, loose stools, abdominal pain\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cdiv class=\"separator\" style=\"clear: both; text-align: center;\"\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003Cp\u003EPast history: In Febuary 2023, patient developed abdominal tightness and chest discomfort and was hospitalized outside. Endoscopy was done there and he was diagnosed to have Antral gastritis.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cdiv class=\"separator\" style=\"clear: both; text-align: center;\"\u003E\u003Ca href=\"https:\/\/blogger.googleusercontent.com\/img\/b\/R29vZ2xl\/AVvXsEhPzO-sc6qTFLiw9rPAh5OnSgVttCEQa65_b-Xq18LCUfdp4hZtzhGxZwWkkX2AWyteleKzmZis8UtHzkBG2jhwq6HQNIHqCfERxoz6Sfxue29XWLVMSEiwvkwgLfXzUaRjk6VdwXsyupr8SrwtJCKM55TOM2YlJnHTGgurR_zxKR-mGGTQAMuIfxuX\/s2856\/20230608_073901.jpg\" style=\"margin-left: 1em; margin-right: 1em;\"\u003E\u003Cimg border=\"0\" data-original-height=\"2253\" data-original-width=\"2856\" height=\"396\" src=\"https:\/\/blogger.googleusercontent.com\/img\/b\/R29vZ2xl\/AVvXsEhPzO-sc6qTFLiw9rPAh5OnSgVttCEQa65_b-Xq18LCUfdp4hZtzhGxZwWkkX2AWyteleKzmZis8UtHzkBG2jhwq6HQNIHqCfERxoz6Sfxue29XWLVMSEiwvkwgLfXzUaRjk6VdwXsyupr8SrwtJCKM55TOM2YlJnHTGgurR_zxKR-mGGTQAMuIfxuX\/w388-h396\/20230608_073901.jpg\" width=\"388\" \/\u003E\u003C\/a\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E1 month back patient presented with complaints of abdominal distension, pedal edema, lower back ache. He was hospitalized and found to have diabetes mellitus type 2 along with Chronic Kidney Disease. An MRI of lumbo sacral spine showed mild canal stenosis at L4-L5 and moderate canal stenosis at L3-L4 (early lumbar spondylosis with mild facetal arthropathy).\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cdiv class=\"separator\" style=\"clear: both; text-align: center;\"\u003E\u003Ca href=\"https:\/\/blogger.googleusercontent.com\/img\/b\/R29vZ2xl\/AVvXsEhzmiXCNuzURLzK8oponLUbabTlOBoRV1RfuKjyQb8NVrpmuxKdF9_LoHA9m-oT8ZElH4v1FRTYdy6qyhzsNop2OKhk6UV15KLAMb0xT6HQPYwdpNUBJLO2vOa407p-fa8hHMHFbCXIx4S7Iclu2jXIS7V-PKWS6PzXXpvz1ZjFl9oN0xAQmn0YkPtG\/s3837\/20230608_074244.jpg\" style=\"margin-left: 1em; margin-right: 1em;\"\u003E\u003Cimg border=\"0\" data-original-height=\"3837\" data-original-width=\"2558\" height=\"441\" src=\"https:\/\/blogger.googleusercontent.com\/img\/b\/R29vZ2xl\/AVvXsEhzmiXCNuzURLzK8oponLUbabTlOBoRV1RfuKjyQb8NVrpmuxKdF9_LoHA9m-oT8ZElH4v1FRTYdy6qyhzsNop2OKhk6UV15KLAMb0xT6HQPYwdpNUBJLO2vOa407p-fa8hHMHFbCXIx4S7Iclu2jXIS7V-PKWS6PzXXpvz1ZjFl9oN0xAQmn0YkPtG\/w294-h441\/20230608_074244.jpg\" width=\"294\" \/\u003E\u003C\/a\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003Cdiv class=\"separator\" style=\"clear: both; text-align: center;\"\u003E\u003Ca href=\"https:\/\/blogger.googleusercontent.com\/img\/b\/R29vZ2xl\/AVvXsEhX3GKiUiBKe21lFF5asbblhSEDg7oHOTEC4k71ZKHCaxj6RQd0W6lncjR97qXoZq5rhi9PajjNS6Qb4FZInsQfVuEHWMn2n2q-6AHmgwpMrmzo79yTAevpQ4EODCZrEd-n1s1DzIVchhQ\/s4032\/20230608_074331.jpg\" style=\"margin-left: 1em; margin-right: 1em;\"\u003E\u003Cimg border=\"0\" data-original-height=\"4032\" data-original-width=\"2317\" height=\"551\" src=\"https:\/\/blogger.googleusercontent.com\/img\/b\/R29vZ2xl\/AVvXsEhX3GKiUiBKe21lFF5asbblhSEDg7oHOTEC4k71ZKHCaxj6RQd0W6lncjR97qXoZq5rhi9PajjNS6Qb4FZInsQfVuEHWMn2n2q-6AHmgwpMrmzo79yTAevpQ4EODCZrEd-n1s1DzIVchhQ\/w318-h551\/20230608_074331.jpg\" width=\"318\" \/\u003E\u003C\/a\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EHe is a k\/c\/o Hypertension since 4 years, on Tab. STAMLO BETA 0.5 mg PO\/OD.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EFor his Type 2 DM, for 1 month, he has been taking Inj. discussion on 70 year old with giddiness"},"content":{"type":"html","$t":"\u003Cp\u003E\u0026nbsp;This is an online E logbook to discuss our patients' de-identified health data shared after taking his\/her\/guardian's signed informed consent. Here we discuss our individual patient's problems through series of inputs from the available global online community of experts intending to solve those patients' clinical problems with the collective current best evidence-based inputs. This e-log book also reflects my patient-centered online learning portfolio and your valuable inputs on the comment box are welcome.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u0026nbsp;I have been given this case to solve in an attempt to understand the topic of \" Patient clinical data analysis\" to develop my competency in reading and comprehending clinical data including history, clinical findings, and investigations, and come up with a diagnosis and treatment plan.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ECASE DISCUSSION\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E70 year old female, resident of Mothkur was brought to casuality with a\/h\/o fall. She has had giddiness since 1 week, similar episodes of falls- 3 episodes since 1 week.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThe attenders give complaints of altered sensorium since 8 hours, deviation of angle of mouth since 8 hours, slurring of speech since 8 hours.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EHOPI: Patient was apparently asymptomatic 1 week ago, then she developed giddiness which was sudden in onset and gradually progressive. It was not associated with hearing loss, tinnitus,postural fall or aggravation with position change.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EH\/o fall, 3 episodes since 1 week. The falls were associated with external injuries, with one time, leading to suturing done on chin outside.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cdiv class=\"separator\" style=\"clear: both; text-align: center;\"\u003E\u003Ca href=\"https:\/\/blogger.googleusercontent.com\/img\/b\/R29vZ2xl\/AVvXsEgj_sa-K8KFcymvarjPvb01FwKi37KSuAQHqNARhRU_M3OG55oJvTlRnLMuYdLbueV825-ueDfWi804yVdGg-8-LK1qr4RS6AZ9Gs4XSqcUMKDHSIa3Ad5X2uH9FC-NsNIjXgTtsZkBa6jwLYao7umd86YX7IwyHkZq07YwJtIaFXunZdXKqVpG2rFL\/s3774\/20230603_104109.jpg\" style=\"margin-left: 1em; margin-right: 1em;\"\u003E\u003Cimg border=\"0\" data-original-height=\"2856\" data-original-width=\"3774\" height=\"276\" src=\"https:\/\/blogger.googleusercontent.com\/img\/b\/R29vZ2xl\/AVvXsEgj_sa-K8KFcymvarjPvb01FwKi37KSuAQHqNARhRU_M3OG55oJvTlRnLMuYdLbueV825-ueDfWi804yVdGg-8-LK1qr4RS6AZ9Gs4XSqcUMKDHSIa3Ad5X2uH9FC-NsNIjXgTtsZkBa6jwLYao7umd86YX7IwyHkZq07YwJtIaFXunZdXKqVpG2rFL\/w365-h276\/20230603_104109.jpg\" width=\"365\" \/\u003E\u003C\/a\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ESince 8 hours, the patient has had altered sensorium and is irritable. She also has deviation of angle of mouth and slurring of speech.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ENo h\/o fever, cough, shortness of breath, vomiting, loose stools, pain abdomen\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EPast history: k\/c\/o seizure disorder since 15 years, on Tab. EPTOIN 200 mg PO\/BD\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E15 years back, Patient started having episodes of seizures where she would have an aura and then fall with thrashing of limbs. The episode was associated with loss of consciousness for 5 minutes and foaming at mouth. There would be confusion after the episode of seizure. She has been using medication since 15 years but would still have occasional episodes.
